title: Realistic Raccoon 3D Model
creator: Pigcraft
credit: "Realistic Raccoon 3D Model" by Pigcraft (https://sketchfab.com/s8819296), CC BY 4.0, adapted (simplified from 1.89 million to 20,000 triangles, 19 pieces joined, turned to face along its body, textures to 2048 and 1024, given a skeleton, a walk, trot, gallop and sit by Meadowlark Ranch's autorig, scaled) for Meadowlark Ranch.
notes: The creator describes the model as AI-assisted; the CC BY 4.0 grant on Sketchfab was live when it was checked on 2026-10-01.

contents.pose: standing mid-stride, head turned a little to its right

changes: the 19 pieces joined into one mesh, welded on position and texture coordinate, simplified with meshoptimizer (normals and texture coordinates weighted) to 19,999 triangles and 21,562 vertices
turned 13 degrees about the vertical (and moved 1.9 cm sideways) so the body's long axis lies along +Z with the hips over x = 0

colour texture 4096 -> 2048 JPEG; normal map 4096 PNG -> 1024 JPEG on the same texture coordinates; the roughness-metallic map dropped (roughness 0.84, metallic 0); tangents and the duplicate texture coordinate sets dropped

the normal map's strength set to 0.25 (normalTexture.scale): at full strength its noisy normals, from a texture atlas of thousands of small pieces, caught the game's rim light and frosted the fur with white flecks
nothing else in the file; at load assets/pet-autorig.js builds the skeleton and skin weights and bakes the clips
